title: 旋回台付き平口バイス
description: 工房・学校の作業台に取り付ける平口バイス。開いた平行口金と細い把持溝、固定側と移動側の鋳物風胴体、角形スライド、露出した送りねじとT字ハンドル、小さな後部金敷、旋回台と実開口の取付耳・固定レバーを造形。丸管用三脚バイスとは異なる机上固定の平口工具です。台・取付ボルト・加工物は含まず、締付動作や保持力の検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.513 × 0.218 × 0.254 m、7,620三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A flat-jaw vise for mounting on workshop or school benches. It has open parallel jaws with fine gripping ridges, cast-style fixed/moving bodies, square slide, exposed lead screw/T handle, small rear anvil, swivel base and genuinely open mounting ears with locking levers. This bench-mounted flat-jaw tool differs from a tripod pipe vise. Bench, mounting bolts and workpiece are absent; clamping motion and holding force are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.513 × 0.218 × 0.254 m; 7,620 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
